name: Phone list
what: A phone rises and floats while a list fills its screen row by row - each row slides in from the right and its icon pops; at the end the rows can slide away. Apps, features, steps, tips.

learned_from.what: a phone whose app rows slide in one after another

motion: the phone up 20 f (slow end) and floats; a row every 7 f: in 14 f (power3.out), the icon back.out; out 3 f apart
